1	function _getLoanDetails(LibAppStorage.StorageLayout storage s, uint256 _loanId)
2	        internal
3	        view
4	        returns (
5	            uint256 positionId,
6	            address token,
7	            uint256 principal,
8	            uint256 repaid,
9	            uint256 tenureSeconds,
10	            uint256 startTimestamp,
11	            uint256 debt,
12	            uint16 annualRateBps,
13	            uint16 penaltyRateBps,
14	            uint8 status
15	        )
16	    {
17	        Loan memory loan = s.s_loans[_loanId];
18	        return (
19	            loan.positionId,
20	            loan.token,
21	            loan.principal == 0 ? s.s_loanPrincipal[_loanId] : loan.principal,
22	            loan.repaid,
23	            loan.tenureSeconds,
24	            s.s_loanStartTime[_loanId] == 0 ? loan.startTimestamp : s.s_loanStartTime[_loanId],
25	            _outstandingBalance(s, _loanId, block.timestamp),
26	            loan.annualRateBps,
27	            loan.penaltyRateBps,
28	            uint8(loan.status)
29	        );
30	    }
